title: Artesunate Promotes Bone Remodeling Through TRAF6-Mediated NF-kappaB Signaling Under Orthodontic Stress in Diabetic Rats.
authors: Zhan, Yuxiang; Zhang, Siqin; Yang, Minjie; Wang, Yuchen; Li, Jiaquan; Nong, Xiaolin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究青蒿琥酯在糖尿病大鼠正畸应力下经TRAF6/NF-kB信号促进骨重塑，虽含分子对接但核心为骨代谢与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: OBJECTIVES: To determine the effects of artesunate (ART) on bone remodeling in vivo under orthodontic stress in diabetic rats and explore the underlying mechanisms in vitro. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A rat model of type 2 diabetes mellitus with orthodontic tooth movement was established. The rats received ART and/or metformin (Met) orally. The effects of ART and Met on periodontium changes were evaluated using tartrate-resistant acid phosphatase and immunohistochemical staining. Molecular docking analyses were employed to investigate the mechanisms of ART action. In vitro, the effects of ART on osteogenic and osteoclastic activity were explored by examining TRAF6 and NF-kappaB expression under hyperglycemic and static pressure conditions via immunofluorescence and Western blotting. RESULTS: ART enhanced bone metabolism despite hyperglycemia, though mechanical stress still induced bone resorption. Treatment with ART alone or in combination with Met promoted osteogenesis. TRAF6, NF-kappaB and the OPG/RANKL/RANK signaling pathways have been identified as key mediators of these effects. The expression of the osteogenesis-associated factor OPG increased after ART and Met treatment, while that of TRAF6 and the osteoclast-associated factors RANKL and NF-kappaB decreased. CONCLUSIONS: Increased bone resorption and decreased bone formation are characteristics of type 2 diabetes, impacting orthodontic tooth movement. ART administration alone promotes bone remodeling under static pressure and hyperglycemic conditions. These effects are mediated by lowering blood sugar levels, inhibiting osteoclast function, and improving osteogenesis through mechanisms closely associated with the OPG/TRAF6/NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 目的：探讨青蒿琥酯（ART）对糖尿病大鼠正畸应力下体内骨重塑的影响，并在体外探究其潜在机制。材料与方法：建立2型糖尿病伴正畸牙齿移动的大鼠模型，大鼠口服ART和/或二甲双胍（Met）。采用抗酒石酸酸性磷酸酶染色和免疫组织化学染色评估ART和Met对牙周组织变化的影响。运用分子对接分析研究ART的作用机制。在体外，通过免疫荧光和Western blotting检测高糖及静压力条件下TRAF6和NF-kappaB的表达，探讨ART对成骨和破骨活性的影响。结果：尽管存在高血糖，ART仍增强骨代谢，但机械应力仍诱导骨吸收。单独使用ART或与Met联合治疗促进成骨。TRAF6、NF-kappaB及OPG/RANKL/RANK信号通路被确定为这些效应的关键介质。ART和Met治疗后，成骨相关因子OPG的表达增加，而TRAF6及破骨相关因子RANKL和NF-kappaB的表达降低。结论：骨吸收增加和骨形成减少是2型糖尿病的特征，影响正畸牙齿移动。单独给予ART在静压力和高糖条件下促进骨重塑。这些效应通过降低血糖水平、抑制破骨细胞功能及改善成骨实现，其机制与OPG/TRAF6/NF-kappaB信号通路密切相关。
